content.comment_body: Hello, My question might seem basic, but I'm just starting to use text displays. I'm currently working with a [product_name] and a [product_name] display. In my program, I have set up: 1. A state (hi) 2. A message text showing the current date and time with low priority, meant to appear when the program is inactive. 3. Memento However, the displayed time does not refresh—it stays at the value from when the message first appeared.

This is a common issue. There is a way for the time to update regardless—see the attachment. Try adding an analog input to your program, even if none are actively being used. It doesn’t matter whether there’s a sensor connected. Then, in your message text, include an AI element in the ticker area. The AI won’t be shown if the ticker function is disabled, but this helps the time to update.
Thanks very much for your prompt and thorough response! I’ll try that. Have a great day!

analysis.insight_summary: Users experience an issue where the displayed time on the [product_name] display connected to [product_name] does not update after appearing, making it difficult to rely on real-time feedback. A workaround involves adding an unused analog input, highlighting an unintuitive aspect of the design.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the display to update the current time automatically in real-time, without needing extra steps or configuration.
